title: Click-chemistry-based protocol to quantitatively assess fatty acid uptake by Mycobacterium tuberculosis in axenic culture and inside mouse macrophages
protocol: Grow GFP-expressing Mtb strains for 5–7 days in standing culture flask at 37°C until an OD600 of 0.8–1 is reached in 7H9-OADC-Tylox medium containing selection antibiotics.
Centrifuge 1 ml of bacterial culture at 3,000 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and wash the bacterial pellet once with 1 ml of 7H9 broth.
Resuspend washed bacteria in 5 ml of FA-free 7H9-AD medium.
Grow resuspended bacteria for 5–7 days at 37°C until an OD600 of 0.6–0.8 is reached.
Incubate an aliquot of the culture for 15 minutes at 80°C.
Let it cool down to 22°C-25°C before incubation with alkyne FAs.
Alternatively, treat bacteria with 4% PFA for 30 minutes at 22°C-25°C.
Centrifuge treated bacteria at 9,000 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend bacteria in alkyne-FA-supplemented 7H9-AD.
Dilute 8.34 μL of pre-conjugated alkyne FA-BSA in 992 μL of 7H9-AD to achieve a final FA concentration of 5 μM.
For competition assays, add natural FA-BSA at a final concentration of 5–50 μM.
Centrifuge bacteria at 3,000 × g for 5 minutes at 22°C-25°C.
Resuspend bacteria to an OD600 of 0.1 in FA-supplemented medium.
Incubate for 1 hour at 37°C.
Centrifuge bacteria at 3,000 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash bacterial pellets once with ice-cold 7H9-AD medium.
Wash bacterial pellets twice with ice-cold Wash Buffer.
Fix bacteria by incubation in 4% PFA for 1 hour at 22°C-25°C.
Proceed to click chemistry staining and flow cytometry analysis.
Grow Mtb in 7H9-OADC-Tylox medium until late log phase (OD600 = 0.6–0.8).
Incubate bone marrow cells for 24 hours in antibiotic-free BMDM culture medium before infection.
Centrifuge a bacterial culture at 3,000 × g for 5 minutes.
Wash the pellet twice with 30 ml of 1× DPBS.
Resuspend the bacteria in 5 ml of sterile 1× DPBS.
Dissociate bacteria using the RNA01.01 program on a gentleMACS™ dissociator.
Pass the bacterial suspension through a 25G needle (twenty times) and a 27G needle once.
Let the suspension stand for 10 minutes to remove remaining clumps.
Transfer the bacterial suspension into a new tube.
Measure the OD600 of the bacterial suspension.
Dilute Mtb at an OD600 of 0.01–0.02 in antibiotic-free BMDM culture medium for infection.
Replace the culture medium with 5 mL diluted Mtb for 100 mm dish or 200 μL for 24-well plate.
Incubate infected cells for 3 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Wash infected cells 3 times with warm DMEM to remove extracellular bacteria.
Add fresh BMDM culture medium after washing.
Incubate cells for 1 or 3 days at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Dilute pre-conjugated alkyne FA-BSA in BMDM culture medium at a final FA concentration of 5 μM.
Replace cell supernatant with equivalent volume of alkyne FA-supplemented BMDM culture medium.
Incubate for 1 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Replace cell supernatant with an equivalent volume of DMEM GlutaMAX supplemented with 10% FBS.
Incubate for 1 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Isolate intracellular bacteria from infected cells in a 100 mm cell culture dish.
Wash infected BMDMs twice with 5 mL of ice-cold Homogenization Buffer.
Add 5 mL of ice-cold Homogenization Buffer and incubate for 10–15 min at 4°C.
Scrape BMDMs with a cell scraper and transfer cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge cells at 500 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of Homogenization Buffer.
Pass the cells at least 20–25 times through a 25G needle, plus once through a 27G needle using a 1 mL syringe.
Keep the cells at 4°C throughout the isolation protocol.
Add 4 mL of Homogenization Buffer to the resuspended pellet.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the supernatant containing most cytoplasmic material from lysed cells to a new tube.
Add 50 μL of 10% Tween 80 (final concentration of 0.1%) to the supernatant.
Pipet up and down vigorously until foam formation occurs.
Incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 1,500 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Resuspend well the bacterial pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold 1× DPBS with 0.05% Tyloxapol.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash with 1 mL of cold 1× DPBS-0.05% Tyloxapol.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash with 1 mL of cold Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend bacteria in 200 μL of 4% PFA.
Incubate 16–20 h at 4°C before staining for flow cytometry analysis.
Wash infected BMDMs cultured on coverslips twice with ice-cold 1× DPBS.
Add 300 μL of 4% PFA and incubate for 1 h at 22°C–25°C.
Wash the cells twice with 500 μL of 1× DPBS.
Add 300 μL of Permeabilization Buffer and incubate for 10 min at 22°C–25°C.
Wash the cells twice with 500 μL of 3% BSA in 1× DPBS.
Add 300 μL of Click-iTTM Plus reaction cocktail.
Incubate for 30 min at 22°C–25°C.
Wash the cells twice with 500 μL of 3% BSA in 1× DPBS.
Add 300 μL of DAPI (1 μg/mL) in 1× DPBS.
Incubate for 5 min at 22°C–25°C.
Wash the cells three times with 500 μL of 1× DPBS, and add the same volume of 1× DPBS.
Using tweezers and a crooked, beveled needle, get coverslips from the wells.
Dab the coverslip edge on a Kim wipe and flip them over onto a drop of Prolong Diamond Antifade Mountant on a glass slide.
Let it cure for 24 h at 22°C–25°C before sealing with nail polish.
Store sealed slides at 4°C.
Image cells using a 63×/1.4 oil objective on a LSM 700 inverted confocal microscope and Zen Imaging software, or equivalent.
Set up the z-scan spanning for imaging most intracellular bacteria fully.
Perform all acquisitions using the same settings for quantification of FA uptake.
Define Mtb and BMDM regions of interest (ROIs) by the GFP and clicked FA signal, respectively.
Measure the mean fluorescence intensity in defined ROIs.
Add 700 μL of Permeabilization Buffer.
Incubate for 15 min at 22°C–25°C.
Add 300 μL of 10% BSA.
Centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 5 min at 22°C–25°C.
Resuspend bacteria in 300 μL of Click-iTTM Plus reaction cocktail.
Incubate for 30 min at 22°C–25°C.
Add 700 μL of cold Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash bacteria twice with 1 mL of cold Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend in 7H9 plus 0.85 g/L NaCl and 0.05% Tyloxapol.
Read samples on a flow cytometer with regular homogenization by pipetting and passage through a 35-μm cell strainer to avoid large clump formation.

Isolate a GFP-expressing strain of Mtb from infected BMDMs at 24 h post infection after pulse-chase exposure to alkyne palmitic (PA), oleic (OA), linoleic (LA), arachidonic (AA) or docosahexaenoic acid (DHA).
Stain imported alkyne FAs by click chemistry of isolated Mtb.
Analyze stained Mtb by flow cytometry based on GFP and clicked FA fluorescence.
Extract data from Laval et al. with permission under the specified Creative Commons license.
Analyze AF647 fluorescence signal in the APC channel.
Use GFP-expressing bacteria isolated from infected macrophages not treated with alkyne-FAs as negative control.
